transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Sarah, I'm calling about my bill and my internet service. I think there's a mistake.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. I just need to verify your account for security purposes. Could I please have your first and last name?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's Michael Moore.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Moore. And do you have your Cymbal Telecom Customer ID handy? It should be on the top of your bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, hold on, let me grab it... Okay, it's CUST-1019.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your account here. For the final verification step, could you please provide the four-digit security PIN you set up with us?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Moore. You're fully verified. Now, how can I help you with your bill and service today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so about two weeks ago, I called to upgrade my internet from the 300 megabit plan to the 1 Gig plan. I just got my new bill, and it's charging me the higher rate for the gigabit speed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see the plan change order here on your account, effective from the first of this month. That sounds correct.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, but that's the problem. I'm paying for it, but I'm not getting it. I've run a few speed tests, and my speeds are exactly the same as they were before. It's still topping out around 300 megabits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, I see. I sincerely apologize for that discrepancy. You should absolutely be receiving the speeds you're paying for. Let me take a deeper look into the technical side of your account. This will just take me a moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. It's just frustrating, you know? I pay the bill on time, and I expect the service to work as advertised.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your frustration, and you are right to call. Let's get this sorted out for you. Okay, I'm reviewing the provisioning records for your service now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What's provisioning?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's the process where our system sends the correct speed profile to the equipment at your home, specifically the Optical Network Terminal, or ONT, that brings the fiber connection into your house. It tells it what speed to deliver.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ah, okay. So did that happen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, this is interesting. I can see the billing system was correctly updated to the Fiber 1 Gig plan. However, looking at the network logs, it appears the corresponding command to update your speed profile failed to sync with your ONT. It seems to be stuck on the old Fiber 300 profile.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So a computer glitch basically?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Essentially, yes. It's a rare system sync lag, but it does happen occasionally. The good news is, I should be able to fix this for you right now from my end.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's a relief. What do you need me to do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm going to manually push the provisioning order through to your equipment. This might cause your internet to disconnect for about a minute. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine. I'm on my cell phone, so it won't cut us off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I am initiating the command now... It's being sent to your ONT. I'll need to place you on a brief hold for about two minutes while the system processes it and confirms the update. Can I place you on hold?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll be back with you shortly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Moore. Are you still with me?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. The command was accepted, and the system is now showing that your connection is provisioned for the full 1 Gigabit speed. To be absolutely sure, I'd like you to run another speed test.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. Should I reboot my router first or anything?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. It's often a good idea. Could you please unplug the power from your Cymbal Wi-Fi router for about 30 seconds, and then plug it back in? Let me know when you've done so.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, it's unplugged now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, you can go ahead and plug it back in.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Plugged back in. The lights are blinking... it takes a minute or two to come back online.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem, I'll wait with you. Just let me know when your computer or device is reconnected to the Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, looks like I'm connected again. The Wi-Fi signal is back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Now, if you could please open a web browser on a computer that's connected directly to the router with an Ethernet cable, if possible, for the most accurate result.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, I'm on my desktop, which is wired in. What website should I use?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can just go to any popular speed testing website. Typing 'speed test' into a search engine should give you a good option right at the top.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'm on one now. Clicking the 'Go' button...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me know what you see.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow... okay. Yep, that's much different. The download is showing... 938 megabits per second. And upload is... 941. That's what I was expecting to see!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic! I'm so glad to hear that. That confirms the speed profile is now correct. My apologies again that it wasn't applied automatically.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, thanks for fixing that. Now... what about the bill? I've paid for two weeks of service I didn't get.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are absolutely right, and we need to make that right. Let's take care of the billing adjustment now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me see. Your old Fiber 300 plan was $55 per month, and the new Fiber 1 Gig plan is $80 per month. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so the difference is $25 per month. The billing cycle started on the 1st, and today is the 15th, so you've gone about half a month without the correct speed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, we need to credit you for half of that monthly difference. Half of $25 is $12.50. I will apply a pro-rated credit of $12.50 to your account immediately.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds fair. So that will just come off my next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. You'll see a line item on your next statement that says 'Service Adjustment Credit' for $12.50. I'm processing that for you right now... one moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, the credit has been successfully applied to your account. The reference number for this credit is CR-771509. Would you like me to repeat that?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's okay, as long as it's on there. I trust you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is. So, to summarize our call today: we've successfully updated your internet service to the full 1 Gigabit speed you ordered, and we've applied a $12.50 credit to your account to compensate for the period you were billed incorrectly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that covers everything. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah. You were very efficient.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Mr. Moore. It was my pleasure to get this resolved for you. I'm glad we could sort it all out on this call.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today? Any other questions about your account or services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's it for me. You've answered all my questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer. I hope you enjoy your new, faster internet speed!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I will! Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Call ended.
